refnamediv.title: NAME
refnamediv.refpurpose: Virtual Pipe Organ Software. Testing performance

refsect1.title: DESCRIPTION
refsect1.para: GrandOrguePerfTest is a commandline tool built together with GrandOrgue to test performance of the computer with different bit depths, sample rates, lossless compression settings, interpolation modes and buffer sizes. Interpolation modes include Linear, Polyphase and High-quality sinc. All three modes play the supplied 48 kHz samples at a 44.1 kHz engine rate to compare interpolation throughput.
It outputs one line for each parameter set to the standard output. This line contains the 'limit:' value. It is the recommended maximum value for the Polyphony field in the GrandOrgan toolbar.
